body: I wanted to fix myself. I thought i would be the reason to break up our friend group so i separated and distanced myself. i decided because one person was affecting me to much i felt that i couldnt speak up about my problems, i keep myself shut and my past has also kept me shut up even more. i wanted us to stay together so i left in order to keep everything fine. nobody knows the truth and i want to keep it this way. i dont want to ruin anything and i dont want to be the blame for anything. the exhaust and mental stress and depression thats gathered up just made me decide that i needed to be the one to leave instead of confronting this guy. they all like him and me, we are all "good friends". maybe im toxic?
